annotations.title: Turn daily guides on or off

description: Use this only when the user asks to turn website guides on or off. Turns daily guides on or off for one app's website. On needs the website verified, in a connected Google Search Console, and a plan that includes them; the error says which is missing. Each morning after that, Apptiller writes at most one guide, only when a search or question is worth one (otherwise it drafts the fix for a page Google shows but few click, in To do), and pauses while 3 wait unpublished.
name: set_site_guides
title: Turn daily guides on or off
